page.overview:
Who is Cado?

In the , recounts the end of his relationship with . She asked him to choose between herself and his , and he chose the . Within, he signs his name as "The Bow Master".

When first approaches in , and his fellow guard will take a defensive stance and demand he identify himself. However, he then notices the on 's belt and realizes who the young hero must be. The two relax their stances and apologizes, inviting the young hero inside to see . and will step aside to allow passage, and will again apologize.

After has had his first meeting with , and will begin to take shifts guarding her home. At noon, will head home to his , whom he refers to very affectionately. However, is utterly shocked and horrified to find that most of the birds have flown away. He is so dismayed by their absence that he breaks down into tears, explaining that his wife has left him and the are all he has. has difficulty holding himself together, startling with his sudden sobbing.

When returns all of the , will excitedly inform him that they have all returned. He thanks for his help and gives him a as a reward. With his back at his side, asserts he is ready to face the world again. However, he still wishes that would come back to him. This completes the .
